feature.label: AfterGit Merge Resolver: AI Agents (MCP)
feature.description: Lets AI agents you run yourself read the merge conflicts of the workspace over the Model Context Protocol and propose resolutions, which you review in AfterGit. Off until you allow it under Preferences > AfterGit > AI Agents (MCP). AfterGit works without this feature.
